lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Long ago, one crystal held every realm under a single sky. It was called the Aether Sigil.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then it broke. Twelve prisms scattered, the realms drifted apart, and the sky has been cracking ever since.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Twelve keepers raised twelve towers around the prisms. That was an age ago. The towers are tired now.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Elio. The isle dropped another span last night. The skystone under Lowmere is going dark.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then I'm going. The towers hold the prisms, and the prisms hold the realms. Lowmere needs them.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: A prism won't go to a hand that grabs it. The keepers will test you, chamber by chamber, all the way up.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Here. I cut your Player Sigil from the shard that fell on our roof. The one Pell hatched beside.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Warm. Bright. Elio goes, Pell goes.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Remember: a Summoner never steps onto the board. You stand behind the Sigil. Your monsters stand for you.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: And if the Sigil falls, the battle's lost. I know. You've told me every night since I was six.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Another summoner off the edge-isles? Save the speeches. I'm taking the first prism before noon.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then I'll see you at the Verdant Spire.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Twelve towers. Twelve keepers. One Summoner who means to awaken the world through what he summons.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In the Sunforge, eleven facets burn in the Player Sigil. The twelfth, the Mixed Prism, rises in every color at once.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One by one, the keepers arrive: Lyra, Varen, Niko, Rhea, Renn, Zara, Cira, Tarin, Silas, Sera and Mako.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: Don't look so surprised, Ari. Light and Dark have always been rivals. Rivals show up.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Cira. ...You came.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Ari wanted one light. But a prism doesn't make one light. It splits it into every color there is.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: Clear enough to show all of them.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: So the Sigil can't sit on a throne. It has to be held by everyone it holds together.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Keepers, put a hand to your prism. Not to give it up. To hold it with me.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Twelve of us at one table again. ...Fine. Just this once.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: On my count, then. Discipline to the last.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell too! Pell holds too!

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: I spent an age building a legacy to finish alone. Perhaps a legacy is only what you hand to others.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Twelve facets, twelve keepers, one Summoner. The Aether Sigil reforms, not as a crown, but as a ring of light.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Above them, the crack in the sky begins, slowly, to close.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Worlds called. We answered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Prism Realms still float apart. But now they drift together, held by twelve towers whose doors stay open.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Lowmere's skystone glows again. The bell rang this morning by itself. I'm choosing to call that a good sign.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Rematch. Verdant Spire, tomorrow, noon. I've been training a fusion you've never seen.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: You're on. Bring your whole team. I'll bring mine.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell is evolving! ...Pell thinks Pell is evolving.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Collect. Command. Evolve. Conquer. And when the worlds call again, answer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Verdant Spire. Living bridges creak between terraces, and pollen storms roll up the stairs like weather.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: The bridges are moving. They're growing while we walk on them.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Green smell. Happy smell.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Roots in the walls, pollen in the vents. I'll be at the top before you finish sneezing.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: All the way to the tenth chamber! Oh, your monsters look tired. Good. Tired means they tried.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: I'm Lyra Quill, keeper of the Spire. I don't wait for an opening. Spring doesn't wait either.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Kess said you'd hit fast.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: Kess was right and still lost. Speed isn't the test. The test is what grows in your team when it gets hit.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: Every knockout feeds the roots here. Each one that falls makes the whole board run faster.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then we hold the capsule nodes and let you come to us.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell ready.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: Ha! You held, and your monsters grew while they held. That's restoration. Not undoing harm. Outgrowing it.

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: Take the Sigil Core. The Nature Prism has been humming at you since you walked in.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Lowmere is falling. Will one prism stop it?

lines.speaker: Lyra Quill
lines.text: No. I've regrown this tower a hundred times and the sky still cracks. Whatever broke it isn't down here.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Nature Prism settles into the Player Sigil. A new facet lights, green as new leaves.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Ember Bastion. Lava runs in channels under collapsing platforms, and the heat vents breathe on a count.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Every vent fires on the same rhythm. Someone built this place to be learned.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Or to be burned through. Water drowns Fire. I packed accordingly.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Hot. Pell stays behind Elio.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: Stand straight, Summoner. You are in the Bastion of Varen Lux, and you will be measured.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: Strength is common. Discipline is rare. Show me which one you carried up those stairs.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: I brought a plan. Hold the bridges, let the vents do the work.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: A plan is only discipline if it survives the first loss. And my squad will not stand still for you.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: The platforms fall in order. Learn the order, or learn the drop.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell counts vents. One, two... hot.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: You never chased me. Not once. You simply let me run out of floor.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: That is discipline: choosing when not to strike. The Fire Prism is yours. Keep that cool head.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Lyra said the break isn't down here. Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: Above. Always above. The Sunforge Throne burns at the top of the sky.

lines.speaker: Varen Lux
lines.text: Its keeper speaks rarely, and never to me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Tideglass Citadel. Flood gates turn with the tide, and every corridor is a glass tunnel under moving water.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: The floor plan changes every time the gates turn.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Chamber six had a stargazer in it. He beat me, then said I'd be back. Who says that?

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: Chamber six is mine today, Summoner. Don't keep me waiting. I came a long way to see if you're real.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Strange man. Nice stars.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: Hey, you're the one who beat Varen without chasing him. Nice. I like a summoner who doesn't push.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: Because whatever you push in here comes right back at you. The tide's like that. I'm like that.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: So you punish every attack.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: I answer every attack. Big difference. Hit me hard and I'll show you exactly how hard.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: The water reshapes the board every round. The only plan that lasts here is one you're willing to drop.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Water moves. Pell moves.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: You switched formation three times! You stopped trying to win my way and started winning the tide's way.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: The Water Prism's yours. Adaptation's the trick, Summoner. You'll need it higher up, where things get cold.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Three prisms. Maren says Lowmere's skystone flickered last night.

lines.speaker: Niko Ardent
lines.text: Flickered, huh? So the prisms don't heal alone. They heal together. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Frost Meridian. Frozen stairs climb through blizzard zones, and brittle ice cracks under anything that waits.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Don't say anything. Chamber nine froze my whole squad for three turns. I couldn't move a single piece.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then climb with me. Two summoners, one climb.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Absolutely not. I'll watch. Somebody should see you freeze.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Cold. Pell's fur is big now.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Go home, Summoner. Nobody comes this high for good reasons.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Home is the reason. Lowmere is drifting into the crack.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Then you already know what the sky does to things that lean on each other. They fall together.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: I don't hit hard. I slow you, chill you, and wait. Most teams break themselves.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Resilience is what's left when no one is coming to help. Show me yours.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell is here. Elio is not alone.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Your team kept warming each other. Guarding, swapping, covering the frozen ones. I never planned for that.

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: Take the Ice Prism. ...The keepers used to meet, you know. Twelve of us at one table. Before the towers.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Rhea Volt
lines.text: We each locked our prism away to keep it safe. Now no one remembers why we stopped talking. Ask the Archive.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Four facets glow in the Player Sigil. Far below, Lowmere stops sinking. For now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Iron Labyrinth. Walls slide on rails, magnetic fields drag at metal, and every corridor resets on a timer.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Elio, can you hear me? Your team is strong enough now to try a fusion. Two monsters, one bond.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Fusion. Two of my team become one. Is that safe for them?

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Only if they choose it. They will, if they trust you. The Labyrinth will ask for something new.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Walls move. Pell does not like walls that move.

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: You reached the core chamber in forty-one turns. Above average. Hello. I'm Renn Calder.

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: Every tile you'll touch here, I've already planned. Every corridor is a sum. Most summoners never finish it.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: What if I don't solve it? What if I just keep going?

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: Then you'll hit every trap I built. Persistence without logic is noise. Logic without persistence is a drawing.

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: Also, I've been measuring the sky. The crack grows faster every year the prisms stay apart.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell thinks... left?

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: You walked into three traps on purpose to open a fourth path. That isn't in my notes. I'm adding it.

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: The Metal Prism. Yours. And my data: the fracture feeds on separation. Every sealed prism widens it.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then the towers aren't holding the sky together. They're keeping it apart.

lines.speaker: Renn Calder
lines.text: That's the hypothesis. I can't prove it from a labyrinth. Someone higher up decided this. Someone old.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Storm Crown. Floating platforms drift along gust lanes, and lightning rods hum before every strike.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Zara Nyx summons mid-battle, constantly. Her side of the board never stays the same size twice.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: You sound like a fan.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: I am a fan. Tell no one. Beat her anyway.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Wind sings. Pell sings back.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: Finally! I've watched you climb through my clouds. You hold your team so tight, Summoner.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: My monsters come and go like weather. I summon, they fly, I summon again. Nothing up here stays caged.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: My team stays together. That's how we got this far.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: Together isn't the same as held. Loosen your grip. Let one of them surprise you.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: Change is coming down from the top of the sky. I can smell it on the wind. Are you ready for it?

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell wants to fly.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: There it is! Your little one broke formation and took the gust lane on its own. And you let it.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: I didn't let it. It just knew.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: That's the whole lesson. Take the Wind Prism. Freedom isn't chaos, Summoner. It's trust.

lines.speaker: Zara Nyx
lines.text: One more thing. The Sunforge keeper, Ari Zephyr? Taught me to fly. Hasn't left the Throne in a very long time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Obsidian Eclipse. Shadow tiles swallow the light, teleport gates blink open, and nothing is where it looks.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Elio, I'm in chamber eight. Or chamber two. The gates keep showing me the same room.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Stay put. Watch the Symbol, not the shadows. The Symbol doesn't lie.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell sees two Kesses. One is fake.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: Six prisms' worth of light, walking into my eclipse. Ari would be so proud of you.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: You know the Sunforge keeper.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: Light and Dark, Summoner. Rivals since the first sky. Ari wants the prisms forged into one crown. One realm. One light.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: And you've been carrying them up the stairs like a good little courier.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: I don't fight close. I'll find you from the dark and pick your formation apart. Show me what's real.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Elio. The Symbol. Watch the Symbol.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: You ignored every illusion and aimed at the one thing I couldn't fake. Annoying. Brilliant.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: Take the Dark Prism. I wanted them all, you know. To stop Ari. Ambition is just fear in a nicer coat.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then help me stop it a different way.

lines.speaker: Cira Dawn
lines.text: Maybe. Go to the Archive first. Tarin remembers what the rest of us chose to forget.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Sunken Archive. Ruins rest under still water, and relic switches open chambers sealed for ages.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Rhea said ask the Archive. Cira said ask Tarin. Everyone keeps sending me into the past.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: I'm coming in with you this time. I want to know what I've been climbing for, too.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Old books. Old dust. Pell sneezes.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: Welcome. Mind the shelves; some of them bite. I am Tarin Moss, and I remember everything that was.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: The Sigil did not shatter by accident. A summoner once held all twelve facets and tried to command the sky alone.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: The Sigil refused. It broke rather than obey. That summoner was Ari Zephyr.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: And the towers?

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: Ari's grief. Twelve walls to keep the pieces safe until someone could carry them back up. Up to the Throne.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: I will not move from this chamber. My walls have stood for ages. If you want the rest, outlast them.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell is patient. Pell is very patient.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: You did not break my walls. You waited until they forgot why they were standing. Well played.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: The Ancient Prism. Carry it gently. It remembers the sky whole.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: If I bring all twelve to Ari, the same thing could happen again.

lines.speaker: Tarin Moss
lines.text: Or not. The past is a record, Summoner, not a prophecy. Ask Silas what else could happen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Eight facets. The Player Sigil is heavy now, and warm. Lowmere has risen half a span.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Astral Observatory. Platforms orbit a central spire, gravity thins near the star gates, and the stars move.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: Elio. In most futures you arrive at dusk. It is dusk. Welcome back.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: You were in chamber six of the Citadel. You knew I'd come.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: I knew you might. Might is the most interesting word there is.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Stars so close. Pell can almost touch them.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: I've watched a thousand endings to your climb. In most, you hand Ari twelve prisms and the sky breaks again.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: And in the rest?

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: In the rest, you do something I can't see clearly. That's why I came down to the Citadel. To check you were real.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: I shape the board as we play. Orbits shift, low ground becomes high ground. The terrain is mine.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: Win anyway, and maybe the future I can't see becomes the one we get.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell picks the good future.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: There. That move. I didn't see it coming in any version. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: The Space Prism. Nine of twelve. The Sigil was never meant to be held, Summoner. It was meant to be shared.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Shared by who?

lines.speaker: Silas Wren
lines.text: Ask the Sanctum. Sera has been polishing the pieces of that answer for a long time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Crystal Sanctum. Prism bridges carry beams of light, and resonance nodes ring when power passes.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: The nodes ring when your Sigil goes by. Like they know it.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Nine facets. It's starting to sound like a chord.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pretty. Too pretty. Pell is careful.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: Summoner. Your Sigil is crowded. Nine prisms, every one of them shouting a different color.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: Ari believes the realms broke because they were too many things. One light, one realm. I have wondered if Ari is right.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Then why fight me instead of helping Ari?

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: Because no light passes through a bond I haven't tested. Ascension needs a clear vessel.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: I take what you rely on. Your nodes, your cores, your easy answers. What remains is what you truly are.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell stays. Pell is not a resource.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: I took everything I could reach. Your team simply gave each other the rest.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: ...A prism does not purify light by making it one color. It makes it clear enough to show all of them.

lines.speaker: Sera Vale
lines.text: Ari has it backwards. Take the Crystal Prism, Summoner. Carry the colors up whole.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Two more.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Rift Frontier. Portals open without warning, tiles phase in and out, and the great crack fills the sky.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: That's it. The tear I've watched from Lowmere every night of my life. It's so much bigger up close.

lines.speaker: Maren Oake
lines.text: Elio, the isle is shaking again. Whatever you're near, it's pulling harder.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell does not like the dark hole. Pell stays close.

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: Summoner! You're late, I'm busy, the sky's leaking. Mako Reed. Let's go, go, go!

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: I live on the edge of this thing, shoving drifting isles back. Little one with a bell tower? Lowmere? Mine.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: You've been holding up my home?

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: Badly! The Aether Prism isn't strong enough alone. Nothing up here is. Out here you move before you understand.

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: I hit first, I hit fast, and the floor won't wait for you to think. Ready or not!

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Not ready. Go anyway.

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: Ha! You jumped through a portal without seeing the other side. That's the only way anything gets done out here.

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: Take the Aether Prism. Lowmere will hold a few days without me. Then it's on you.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Come to the Throne. All of you. If the Sigil is meant to be shared, the keepers should be there.

lines.speaker: Mako Reed
lines.text: A keeper leaving their tower? In this sky? ...Yeah. Alright. I'll spread the word.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Sunforge Throne. Roots, lava, glass, ice, rails, wind, shadow, ruins, stars, crystal and rifts, all at once.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Eleven towers stacked into one. Of course the last one is all of them.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Kess. Thanks for climbing with me.

lines.speaker: Kess Varrow
lines.text: Don't. I'll get emotional, and then I'll lose. Go.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Warm here. Like the shard. Like home.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Elio of Lowmere. Eleven prisms in one Sigil. No one has carried that much light since me.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: I held the whole sky once. I tried to make it one realm, one light, and it broke in my hands.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Since then I have waited for someone strong enough to bring the pieces home, so I could finish it right.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Finish it by making everything the same? That's what broke it.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: It broke because I was alone. With twelve prisms and a summoner's bond, I can forge it whole. A crown for the sky.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Show me your legacy, then. I move across every realm I ever touched. Keep up.

lines.speaker: Pell
lines.text: Pell is not scared. Pell is a little scared.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Your Sigil was never alone on the field. Every one of your monsters could reach it, and every one protected it.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: I commanded. You answered. That is the difference I could not see for so very long.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: The Sigil isn't a crown. It never was.

lines.speaker: Ari Zephyr
lines.text: Then take the last prism, Summoner, and show me what it is.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Capsule ready. Let's see what answers the battlefield gives us.

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: Terrain is changing—switch formation!

lines.speaker: Elio
lines.text: The Symbol is exposed. Everyone, advance!

lines.speaker: Ari Voss
lines.text: The Verdant Spire tests more than strength. It tests whether your team can adapt.

lines.speaker: Ari Voss
lines.text: You're learning the terrain. Then I'll change the tempo.

lines.speaker: Ari Voss
lines.text: I lost the field, not the lesson. Climb higher and face the next keeper.
